loop.label: Empty
loop.did: Opened the app with an empty vault.
loop.shows: The default shell: Slate · Today · Record in the wayfinder, a loop-map rail, the Slate asking “What needs a decision?”, an agent workspace rail, the tray dock.

loop.label: Captured
loop.did: Opened the tray and placed “Hire decision · pipeline scarcity” on the Slate.
loop.shows: Authored context on the Slate, no reads yet, Run reads available.

loop.label: Read · refusal
loop.did: Ran the reads. The fixture auditor was given one bounded refusal.
loop.shows: Three bounded reads; the auditor holds its boundary and says why (REFUSED · VALUES) instead of answering.

loop.label: Corrected
loop.did: Chose the analyst's read, typed a correction, named the kind (Emergence) and the outcome (Pursue).
loop.shows: The correction becomes part of the record before anything is saved; Save to vault is now enabled.

loop.label: Saved
loop.shows: The decision record status reads “saved · not verified”. The browser fixture cannot sign, and the app says so rather than pretending.

loop.label: Record
loop.shows: The Record drill-in with the summary and proof guide; the saved packet is listed with its verification state.

loop.label: Record · the row
loop.shows: The packet row itself, below the fold, marked UNVERIFIED. The baseline PR logs this placement as a known defect to fix, not a feature.

loop.label: Today
loop.shows: Re-entry: the decision just made comes back as something to return to, with Open record.

surfaces.label: Slate
surfaces.note: Loop map · Slate · agent workspace · tray dock. The goal brief card (PR #450) sits on the Slate.

surfaces.label: Record
surfaces.note: Packet list, verification states, proof guide.

surfaces.label: Authorize
surfaces.note: Empty in this fixture: “Nothing needs your decision.” The queue drains; it does not scroll.

surfaces.label: Spend
surfaces.note: Steps qualify → import → review → reconcile → allocate → triage → decide → control → verify → export, mapped to sense · examine · decide · prove.

surfaces.label: Settings
surfaces.description: ⌘, · General, Model runtime, Connectors, Feeds, Vault data, Diagnostics

shipped.capability: Tray loop: drag context in, a bounded agent panel reads it, you correct the read, the vault holds the record
Operating plane is the default shell (Slate · Today · Record, tools under one menu)
Startup gate: the app stays hidden until vault recovery is clear and one model connection is verified
Goal-alignment steering, with goals as part of the record; Goal Lens as a drill-in
Correction ledger: a goal edit appends {prior, new, actor, timestamp, scope}, ledger before config, refusal on append failure
Verdict allowlist fails closed to a named refusal; RefusalKind is a closed enum validated on parse
Quote grounding enforced by rewrite, not by prompt
Receipt-chain verification at the product boundary
Correction → proposed policy → ratify / revoke / propagate, with agent attribution
Deterministic visual baseline of the core loop (8 states × 2 motion modes) committed and gated
